summary.executive_summary: Maya Chen from SignalDesk met with Daniel to discuss support automation for a team processing 18,000 tickets monthly across email, chat, and WhatsApp. Daniel's key requirements include multilingual routing (English, Spanish, Portuguese), EU data residency, SOC 2 Type II compliance, and a budget cap of $3,800/month for 250 seats. Maya proposes a 15% pilot discount bringing the monthly cost to $3,825, and commits to checking with her director on the remaining gap. A technical workshop is scheduled for Thursday, July 23rd at 2:30 PM Eastern, pending security review completion.
key_points: Volume: 18,000 tickets per month across email, chat, and WhatsApp.
Weekend first response time of 11 hours is a critical pain point.
Multilingual routing required: English, Spanish, and Portuguese.
EU data residency and SOC 2 Type II report are mandatory legal requirements.
Budget cap: $3,800/month. Standard rate: $4,500 (250 seats × $18). Pilot discount: $3,825.
Technical workshop scheduled: Thursday July 23rd at 2:30 PM Eastern.
VP of Finance holds final purchasing authority; security questionnaire must clear first.
Customer provided fictional alias and internal reference code.

buying_signals: Customer voluntarily scheduled a technical workshop.
Customer stated all three conditions: security, price, and Portuguese routing — will recommend moving forward.
Customer appreciated honesty about unconfirmed WhatsApp media handling.
risks: VP of Finance holds final purchasing authority.
Security questionnaire is a blocker before any commitment.
$25 price gap between pilot discount ($3,825) and budget cap ($3,800) remains unresolved.
inconsistencies: Agent describes a 'seventy-five dollar gap' but $3,825 vs the $3,800 cap is a $25 difference.
insights.tone_notes: Professional and structured throughout. Customer was firm on budget and compliance requirements. Agent handled uncertainty around WhatsApp attachment handling honestly.
